title: Minangkabau music - Wikipedia
text: May 7, 2026 - Music of Minang is a traditional and contemporary ethnic variety of Indonesian music that grows and develops in the Minangkabau culture. Music is generally played by musical instruments such as talempong, saluang, Minang rabab, serunai, rebana, aguang (gong), gandang, gambus, and violin.

text: Music is an important part of the Minang community's rituals and festive activities. Traditionally, performances of Minangkabau music are referred to as pamainan anak nagari (the villager's play), because they thought to have mostly evolved from village culture.

text: Austronesian music nowadays refers to the ongoing evolution and fusion of various cultural influences from foreign and neighbouring cultures. These influences have over the centuries introduced new instruments, styles, and genres, blending age-old elements with newer traditions.
